TRAFFIC UPDATE: (October 2, 2025 at 9:40 p.m.) TCH Fully Re-Opened

Clarenville RCMP advises that the eastbound lanes of the Trans-Canada Highway (TCH), between Goobies and Sunnyside, are back open.

#RCMPNL cautions drivers to slow down and watch for moose on all provincial roadways.

#nltraffic 

******

🚨TRAFFIC ADVISORY: Lane Reduction on the TCH

Clarenville RCMP advises motorists that the eastbound lanes of the Trans-Canada Highway (TCH), between Route 210 in Goobies and the Sunnyside Exit are closed temporarily to allow emergency crews to respond to a moose involved motor vehicle collision.

The westbound lanes of travel remain open at this time, and motorists are asked to drive with caution through the area and follow directions provided by emergency personnel.

Updates to follow

#nltraffic

data.text:
Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Tropical Cyclone "PAOLO"
Issued at: 8:45 AM, 03 October 2025(Friday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Zambales, Bataan, Batangas, Cavite and Quezon(Buenavista, Burdeos, Calauag, Catanauan, General Luna, Guinayangan, Jomalig, Lopez, Macalelon, Mulanay, Panukulan, Patnanungan, Polillo, San Andres, San Francisco, San Narciso, Tagkawayan).
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Metro Manila, Laguna and Pampanga within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Nueva Ecija, Rizal, Bulacan(Baliuag, Bustos, Dona Remedios Trinidad, Pandi, San Ildefonso, San Miguel, Santa Maria, San Rafael, Angat, Norzagaray, San Jose del Monte), Quezon(Candelaria, Dolores, San Antonio, Sariaya, Tiaong, General Nakar, Tayabas, Infanta, Lucban, Lucena, Mauban, Pagbilao, Real, Sampaloc, Agdangan, Alabat, Atimonan, Gumaca, Padre Burgos, Perez, Pitogo, Plaridel, Quezon, Unisan) and Tarlac(Moncada, Camiling, San Clemente, Paniqui, Anao, San Manuel, Ramos) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
